comment: Chopper (BNpcBase 411, Sastasha's first boss, 4035011): 3828 HP, its auto-attack every 3.0 s. From Bob's Chronofoil captures of Sastasha: five Duty Finder runs (2026-10-22) and one with Duty Support (2026-10-23, 700cc294, whose fights ran longest: the Duty Support members took the hits other players would have). `players` is the median damage to players over all six runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses.
